info.name: OAStudio API
info.description:
End-to-end tests for the OAStudio backend. Run the folders in order: later requests use ids saved by earlier ones, and folder 08 deletes everything the run created.

Needs environment variables adminUsername and adminPassword. Folder 05 uploads two 8x8 test images to Cloudinary and deletes them again. Folder 07 creates a temporary admin and deletes it; it needs a free slot (max 5 admins).
